act02.table:auth_account_credentials:
CREATE TABLE `auth_account_credentials` (
  `account_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `password_hash` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `password_changed_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `credential_version` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`account_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_account_credentials_account` FOREIGN KEY (`account_id`) REFERENCES `auth_accounts` (`account_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_account_credentials_version` CHECK ((`credential_version` >= 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
act02.table:auth_account_memberships:
CREATE TABLE `auth_account_memberships` (
  `membership_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `account_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `profile_doctor_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `entity_group_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `role_code` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `scope_code` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `assignment_source` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual_review',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `revoked_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `active_identity_key` varchar(320) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'active',_utf8mb4'suspended')) then concat(`account_id`,_utf8mb4':',coalesce(`profile_doctor_id`,_utf8mb4''),_utf8mb4':',coalesce(`entity_group_id`,_utf8mb4''),_utf8mb4':',`role_code`,_utf8mb4':',`scope_code`) else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`membership_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ux_auth_account_memberships_active_identity` (`active_identity_key`),
  KEY `idx_auth_account_memberships_account_status` (`account_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_auth_account_memberships_profile_status` (`profile_doctor_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_auth_account_memberships_group_status` (`entity_group_id`,`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_account_memberships_account` FOREIGN KEY (`account_id`) REFERENCES `auth_accounts` (`account_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_account_memberships_group` FOREIGN KEY (`entity_group_id`) REFERENCES `medical_groups` (`group_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_account_memberships_profile` FOREIGN KEY (`profile_doctor_id`) REFERENCES `profiles_doctors` (`doctor_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_account_memberships_role` CHECK ((`role_code` in (_utf8mb4'owner',_utf8mb4'administrator',_utf8mb4'collaborator'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_account_memberships_scope` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`scope_code`)) > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_account_memberships_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'active',_utf8mb4'suspended',_utf8mb4'revoked'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_account_memberships_target` CHECK ((((`profile_doctor_id` is not null) and (`entity_group_id` is null)) or ((`profile_doctor_id` is null) and (`entity_group_id` is not null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
act02.table:auth_account_phone_verifications:
CREATE TABLE `auth_account_phone_verifications` (
  `account_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `contact_version` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `contact_digest` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `contact_ciphertext` blob NOT NULL,
  `key_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `challenge_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `challenge_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `session_context` json NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `attempts` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `delivery_accepted` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `send_window_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `send_count` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `last_sent_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `verified_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `audit_reference` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`account_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_phone_verifications_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`account_id`) REFERENCES `auth_accounts` (`account_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_phone_verifications_chk_1` CHECK (((`contact_version` > 0) and (`attempts` <= 5) and (`send_count` between 1 and 5))),
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_phone_verifications_chk_2` CHECK ((`delivery_accepted` in (0,1))),
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_phone_verifications_chk_3` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'VERIFIED',_utf8mb4'REVOKED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_phone_verifications_chk_4` CHECK (((`status` = _utf8mb4'VERIFIED') = (`verified_at` is not null)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
act02.table:auth_account_professional_bindings:
CREATE TABLE `auth_account_professional_bindings` (
  `binding_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `account_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `profile_doctor_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `admission_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `admission_version` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `verified_identity_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `identity_revision_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `credential_revision_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `authority_version` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  `relationship_evidence_reference` varchar(190) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `acceptance_reference` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `audit_reference` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `valid_from` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `valid_until` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reverify_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `active_account` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'SUSPENDED')) then `account_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  `active_profile` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'SUSPENDED')) then `profile_doctor_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  `active_identity` bigint unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'SUSPENDED')) then `verified_identity_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  `evidence_request_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `evidence_version` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`binding_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_professional_binding_account_profile` (`active_account`,`active_profile`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_professional_binding_identity` (`active_identity`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_professional_binding_effective_profile` (`active_profile`),
  KEY `account_id` (`account_id`),
  KEY `profile_doctor_id` (`profile_doctor_id`),
  KEY `verified_identity_id` (`verified_identity_id`),
  KEY `admission_id` (`admission_id`),
  KEY `evidence_request_id` (`evidence_request_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_professional_bindings_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`account_id`) REFERENCES `auth_accounts` (`account_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_professional_bindings_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`profile_doctor_id`) REFERENCES `profiles_doctors` (`doctor_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_professional_bindings_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`verified_identity_id`) REFERENCES `profiles_verified_identities` (`verified_identity_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_professional_bindings_ibfk_4` FOREIGN KEY (`admission_id`) REFERENCES `profiles_physician_admissions` (`admission_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_professional_bindings_ibfk_5` FOREIGN KEY (`evidence_request_id`) REFERENCES `auth_physician_evidence_requests` (`request_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_professional_bindings_chk_1` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'SUSPENDED',_utf8mb4'REVOKED',_utf8mb4'REJECTED',_utf8mb4'EXPIRED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_professional_bindings_chk_2` CHECK (((`authority_version` > 0) and (`admission_version` > 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_professional_bindings_chk_3` CHECK ((regexp_like(`identity_revision_hash`,_ascii'^[a-f0-9]{64}$') and regexp_like(`credential_revision_hash`,_ascii'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'))),
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_professional_bindings_chk_4` CHECK (((`valid_until` is null) or (`valid_until` > `valid_from`))),
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_professional_bindings_chk_5` CHECK (((`reverify_at` is null) or (`reverify_at` > `valid_from`))),
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_professional_bindings_chk_6` CHECK (((char_length(trim(`relationship_evidence_reference`)) > 0) and (char_length(trim(`acceptance_reference`)) > 0) and (char_length(trim(`audit_reference`)) > 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `auth_account_professional_bindings_chk_7` CHECK ((`evidence_version` > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
act02.table:auth_accounts:
CREATE TABLE `auth_accounts` (
  `account_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `email_address` varchar(190) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `email_normalized` varchar(190) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_verification',
  `email_verified_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`account_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ux_auth_accounts_email_normalized` (`email_normalized`),
  KEY `idx_auth_accounts_status` (`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_accounts_email_verified_state` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'pending_verification') and (`email_verified_at` is null)) or (`status` <> _utf8mb4'pending_verification'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_accounts_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending_verification',_utf8mb4'active',_utf8mb4'blocked',_utf8mb4'disabled')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
act02.table:auth_external_trust_anchor_evidenc:
CREATE TABLE `auth_external_trust_anchor_evidence` (
  `trust_anchor_reference` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `operation_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `target_account_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `organization_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `environment_name` varchar(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `case_reference` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `ratifier_session_reference` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `ratifier_one_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `ratifier_two_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `approval_one_reference` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `approval_two_reference` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `payload_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `signature_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'VERIFIED',
  `authorized_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `consumed_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `contract_version` smallint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `operation` varchar(40) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `profile_doctor_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `membership_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `membership_version` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `requester_account_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`trust_anchor_reference`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ux_auth_trust_anchor_operation` (`operation_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ux_auth_trust_anchor_signature` (`signature_hash`),
  KEY `fk_auth_trust_anchor_target` (`target_account_id`),
  KEY `fk_gov03b_trust_profile` (`profile_doctor_id`),
  KEY `fk_gov03b_trust_membership` (`membership_id`),
  KEY `fk_gov03b_trust_requester` (`requester_account_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_trust_anchor_target` FOREIGN KEY (`target_account_id`) REFERENCES `auth_accounts` (`account_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_gov03b_trust_membership` FOREIGN KEY (`membership_id`) REFERENCES `auth_account_memberships` (`membership_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_gov03b_trust_profile` FOREIGN KEY (`profile_doctor_id`) REFERENCES `profiles_doctors` (`doctor_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_gov03b_trust_requester` FOREIGN KEY (`requester_account_id`) REFERENCES `auth_accounts` (`account_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_trust_anchor_ratifiers` CHECK (((`ratifier_one_id` <> `ratifier_two_id`) and (`ratifier_one_id` <> `target_account_id`) and (`ratifier_two_id` <> `target_account_id`))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_trust_anchor_state` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'VERIFIED') and (`consumed_at` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'CONSUMED') and (`consumed_at` is not null)) or ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'REVOKED',_utf8mb4'EXPIRED')) and (`consumed_at` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_trust_anchor_window` CHECK ((`expires_at` > `authorized_at`)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_gov03b_trust_membership_version` CHECK (((`membership_version` is null) or regexp_like(`membership_version`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_gov03b_trust_operation` CHECK (((`operation` is null) or (`operation` in (_utf8mb4'FIRST_DIRECTOR_BOOTSTRAP',_utf8mb4'INITIAL_OWNER',_utf8mb4'OWNER_REPLACEMENT',_utf8mb4'OWNER_REMOVAL',_utf8mb4'MFA_RECOVERY')))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_gov03b_trust_version` CHECK (((`contract_version` is null) or (`contract_version` = 2)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
act02.table:auth_governance_case_endorsements:
CREATE TABLE `auth_governance_case_endorsements` (
  `endorsement_id` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `case_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `endorsement_slot` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `approver_account_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `staff_session_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `credential_version` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `mfa_proof_id` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'APPROVED',
  `approved_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `consumed_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`endorsement_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ux_auth_governance_endorsement_slot` (`case_id`,`endorsement_slot`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ux_auth_governance_endorsement_actor` (`case_id`,`approver_account_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ux_auth_governance_endorsement_mfa` (`mfa_proof_id`),
  KEY `fk_auth_governance_endorsement_actor` (`approver_account_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_governance_endorsement_actor` FOREIGN KEY (`approver_account_id`) REFERENCES `internal_staff` (`account_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_governance_endorsement_case` FOREIGN KEY (`case_id`) REFERENCES `auth_governance_cases` (`case_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_governance_endorsement_mfa` FOREIGN KEY (`mfa_proof_id`) REFERENCES `auth_staff_mfa_proofs` (`proof_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_governance_endorsement_slot` CHECK ((`endorsement_slot` in (1,2))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_governance_endorsement_state` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'APPROVED') and (`consumed_at` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'CONSUMED') and (`consumed_at` is not null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'REVOKED') and (`consumed_at` is null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
act02.table:auth_governance_cases:
CREATE TABLE `auth_governance_cases` (
  `case_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `operation_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `operation` varchar(40) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `requester_account_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `beneficiary_account_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `target_membership_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `replacement_membership_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `profile_doctor_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `reason` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',
  `expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `approved_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `consumed_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `active_target_key` varchar(300) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` in (_utf8mb4'OPEN',_utf8mb4'APPROVED')) then concat(`operation`,_utf8mb4':',`beneficiary_account_id`,_utf8mb4':',coalesce(`profile_doctor_id`,_utf8mb4'')) else NULL end)) STORED,
  `security_context` json DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`case_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ux_auth_governance_case_operation` (`operation_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `ux_auth_governance_case_active_target` (`active_target_key`),
  KEY `idx_auth_governance_case_lifecycle` (`status`,`expires_at`),
  KEY `fk_auth_governance_case_requester` (`requester_account_id`),
  KEY `fk_auth_governance_case_beneficiary` (`beneficiary_account_id`),
  KEY `fk_auth_governance_case_target_membership` (`target_membership_id`),
  KEY `fk_auth_governance_case_replacement_membership` (`replacement_membership_id`),
  KEY `fk_auth_governance_case_profile` (`profile_doctor_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_governance_case_beneficiary` FOREIGN KEY (`beneficiary_account_id`) REFERENCES `auth_accounts` (`account_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_governance_case_profile` FOREIGN KEY (`profile_doctor_id`) REFERENCES `profiles_doctors` (`doctor_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_governance_case_replacement_membership` FOREIGN KEY (`replacement_membership_id`) REFERENCES `auth_account_memberships` (`membership_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_governance_case_requester` FOREIGN KEY (`requester_account_id`) REFERENCES `auth_accounts` (`account_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_governance_case_target_membership` FOREIGN KEY (`target_membership_id`) REFERENCES `auth_account_memberships` (`membership_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_governance_case_operation` CHECK ((`operation` in (_utf8mb4'INITIAL_OWNER',_utf8mb4'OWNER_REPLACEMENT',_utf8mb4'OWNER_REMOVAL',_utf8mb4'FIRST_DIRECTOR_BOOTSTRAP',_utf8mb4'MFA_RECOVERY',_utf8mb4'PHYSICIAN_EVIDENCE_REVIEW',_utf8mb4'PHYSICIAN_AUTHORITY_CHANGE',_utf8mb4'PHYSICIAN_ENROLLMENT_REVIEW',_utf8mb4'PUBLIC_PROFILE_CORRECTION_REVIEW',_utf8mb4'PUBLIC_PROFILE_CORRECTION_APPLY'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_governance_case_reason` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`reason`)) between 8 and 500)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_governance_case_state` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'OPEN') and (`approved_at` is null) and (`consumed_at` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'APPROVED') and (`approved_at` is not null) and (`consumed_at` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'CONSUMED') and (`approved_at` is not null) and (`consumed_at` is not null)) or ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'REVOKED',_utf8mb4'EXPIRED')) and (`consumed_at` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_auth_governance_case_window` CHECK ((`expires_at` > `created_at`))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
act02.table:auth_governance_events:
CREATE TABLE `auth_governance_events` (
  `event_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `case_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `event_type` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `actor_account_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `target_account_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `profile_doctor_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `reason_code` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `evidence_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`event_id`),
  KEY `idx_auth_governance_event_case` (`case_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `fk_auth_governance_event_actor` (`actor_account_id`),
  KEY `fk_auth_governance_event_target` (`target_account_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_auth_governance_event_actor` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_account_id`) REFERENCES `auth_accounts` (`account_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,

  CONSTRAINT `profiles_correction_decisions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`report_id`) REFERENCES `profiles_correction_reports` (`report_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `profiles_correction_decisions_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`reviewer_account_id`) REFERENCES `internal_staff` (`account_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `profiles_correction_decisions_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`case_id`) REFERENCES `auth_governance_cases` (`case_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `profiles_correction_decisions_ibfk_4` FOREIGN KEY (`proof_id`) REFERENCES `auth_staff_mfa_proofs` (`proof_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `profiles_correction_decisions_chk_1` CHECK (((`version` > 1) and (`credential_version` > 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `profiles_correction_decisions_chk_2` CHECK ((`previous_status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING_REVIEW',_utf8mb4'NEEDS_CLARIFICATION'))),
  CONSTRAINT `profiles_correction_decisions_chk_3` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'NEEDS_CLARIFICATION',_utf8mb4'REJECTED',_utf8mb4'ACCEPTED_FOR_APPLICATION'))),
  CONSTRAINT `profiles_correction_decisions_chk_4` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'ACCEPTED_FOR_APPLICATION') and (`reason_code` = _utf8mb4'FACTS_SUPPORTED')) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'NEEDS_CLARIFICATION') and (`reason_code` = _utf8mb4'NEEDS_DETAILS')) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'REJECTED') and (`reason_code` in (_utf8mb4'NOT_SUPPORTED',_utf8mb4'OUT_OF_SCOPE',_utf8mb4'DUPLICATE_REPORT')))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
act02.table:profiles_correction_rate_buckets:

act02.table:profiles_correction_reports:

act02.table:profiles_doctor_credentials:

  `verified_by_account_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_type` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `source_reference` varchar(190) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `active_verified_professional` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when ((`credential_type` = _utf8mb4'PROFESSIONAL') and (`verification_status` = _utf8mb4'VERIFIED') and (`lifecycle_status` = _utf8mb4'ACTIVE')) then `doctor_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`credential_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_credential_owner` (`doctor_id`,`credential_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_credential_license` (`doctor_id`,`license_number`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_active_verified_professional` (`active_verified_professional`),
  KEY `fk_credential_approver` (`verified_by_account_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_credential_approver` FOREIGN KEY (`verified_by_account_id`) REFERENCES `internal_staff` (`account_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_credential_doctor` FOREIGN KEY (`doctor_id`) REFERENCES `profiles_doctors` (`doctor_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_credential_license` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`license_number`)) > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_credential_lifecycle` CHECK ((`lifecycle_status` in (_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'INACTIVE',_utf8mb4'REVOKED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_credential_reference` CHECK (((`source_type` = _utf8mb4'internal_provisioning') or ((`source_reference` is not null) and (char_length(trim(`source_reference`)) > 0)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_credential_source` CHECK ((`source_type` in (_utf8mb4'admission_approved',_utf8mb4'internal_provisioning',_utf8mb4'governed_correction',_utf8mb4'synthetic_test'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_credential_type` CHECK ((`credential_type` in (_utf8mb4'PROFESSIONAL',_utf8mb4'SPECIALTY'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_credential_verification` CHECK ((`verification_status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING_REVIEW',_utf8mb4'VERIFIED',_utf8mb4'REJECTED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_credential_verified` CHECK (((`verification_status` <> _utf8mb4'VERIFIED') or ((`professional_area_label` is not null) and (char_length(trim(`professional_area_label`)) > 0) and (`institution_name` is not null) and (char_length(trim(`institution_name`)) > 0) and (`verified_at` is not null) and (`verified_by_account_id` is not null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

act02.table:profiles_physician_admissions:

  CONSTRAINT `profiles_physician_admissions_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`doctor_id`, `professional_credential_id`) REFERENCES `profiles_doctor_credentials` (`doctor_id`, `credential_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,

  CONSTRAINT `profiles_physician_admissions_chk_2` CHECK ((`authority_version` > 0)),

trigger:auth_governance_events_no_delete: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER `auth_governance_events_no_delete` BEFORE DELETE ON `auth_governance_events` FOR EACH ROW SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'governance_event_delete_forbidden'
trigger:auth_governance_events_no_update: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER `auth_governance_events_no_update` BEFORE UPDATE ON `auth_governance_events` FOR EACH ROW SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'governance_event_update_forbidden'
trigger:c4_enrollment_link_guard:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER `c4_enrollment_link_guard` BEFORE INSERT ON `auth_physician_evidence_requests` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
 IF NEW.enrollment_resolution_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_physician_enrollment_resolutions r
 WHERE r.resolution_id=NEW.enrollment_resolution_id AND r.state='APPROVED' AND r.account_id=NEW.account_id
 AND r.initial_origin=NEW.origin AND r.resolved_profile_doctor_id=NEW.profile_doctor_id
 AND r.verified_identity_id=NEW.verified_identity_id AND r.professional_credential_id=NEW.professional_credential_id
 AND r.identity_revision_hash=NEW.identity_revision_hash AND r.credential_revision_hash=NEW.credential_revision_hash
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_physician_enrollment_resolutions n WHERE n.origin_id=r.origin_id AND n.resolution_version>r.resolution_version))
 THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='c4_enrollment_exact_resolution_required'; END IF;
END
trigger:c4_enrollment_link_immutable:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER `c4_enrollment_link_immutable` BEFORE UPDATE ON `auth_physician_evidence_requests` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
 IF NOT(OLD.enrollment_resolution_id<=>NEW.enrollment_resolution_id)
 THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='c4_enrollment_resolution_immutable'; END IF;
END
trigger:c4_evidence_object_immutable:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER `c4_evidence_object_immutable` BEFORE UPDATE ON `auth_physician_evidence_files` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
 IF NOT (CAST(OLD.file_id AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.file_id AS BINARY)) OR NOT (CAST(OLD.request_id AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.request_id AS BINARY))
  OR NOT (CAST(OLD.kind AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.kind AS BINARY)) OR NOT (CAST(OLD.storage_key AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.storage_key AS BINARY))
  OR NOT (CAST(OLD.key_id AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.key_id AS BINARY)) OR NOT (OLD.ciphertext_hash<=>NEW.ciphertext_hash)
  OR NOT (CAST(OLD.mime_type AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.mime_type AS BINARY)) OR NOT (CAST(OLD.retention_policy_reference AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.retention_policy_reference AS BINARY))
  OR NOT (OLD.source_expires_at<=>NEW.source_expires_at) OR NOT (OLD.created_at<=>NEW.created_at)
 THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='c4_evidence_object_immutable'; END IF;
END
trigger:c4_evidence_origin_immutable:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER `c4_evidence_origin_immutable` BEFORE UPDATE ON `auth_physician_evidence_requests` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
 IF NOT (CAST(OLD.account_id AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.account_id AS BINARY)) OR NOT (CAST(OLD.origin AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.origin AS BINARY))
  OR NOT (CAST(OLD.profile_doctor_id AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.profile_doctor_id AS BINARY)) OR NOT (CAST(OLD.request_id AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.request_id AS BINARY))
  OR NOT (OLD.verified_identity_id<=>NEW.verified_identity_id)
  OR NOT (OLD.professional_credential_id<=>NEW.professional_credential_id)
  OR NOT (OLD.identity_revision_hash<=>NEW.identity_revision_hash)
  OR NOT (OLD.credential_revision_hash<=>NEW.credential_revision_hash)
 THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='c4_evidence_origin_immutable'; END IF;
END
trigger:correction_application_auth_no_d: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER `correction_application_auth_no_delete` BEFORE DELETE ON `profiles_correction_application_authorizations` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='correction_application_immutable'; END
trigger:correction_application_auth_no_u: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER `correction_application_auth_no_update` BEFORE UPDATE ON `profiles_correction_application_authorizations` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='correction_application_immutable'; END
trigger:correction_application_command_g:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER `correction_application_command_guard` BEFORE INSERT ON `profiles_correction_application_commands` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profiles_correction_decisions d JOIN profiles_correction_reports r ON r.report_id=d.report_id

CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER `enrollment_origin_guard` BEFORE UPDATE ON `auth_physician_enrollment_origins` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
 IF NOT(CAST(OLD.origin_id AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.origin_id AS BINARY))
 OR NOT(CAST(OLD.handle_digest AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.handle_digest AS BINARY))
 OR NOT(CAST(OLD.browser_digest AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.browser_digest AS BINARY))
 OR NOT(CAST(OLD.start_digest AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.start_digest AS BINARY))
 OR NOT(CAST(OLD.initial_origin AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.initial_origin AS BINARY))
 OR NOT(CAST(OLD.original_profile_doctor_id AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.original_profile_doctor_id AS BINARY))
 OR NOT(CAST(OLD.original_public_path AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.original_public_path AS BINARY))
 OR NOT(OLD.source_provenance<=>NEW.source_provenance)
 OR NOT(OLD.created_at<=>NEW.created_at) OR NOT(OLD.expires_at<=>NEW.expires_at)
 OR NEW.revision<>OLD.revision+1
 OR (OLD.account_id IS NOT NULL AND (NOT(CAST(OLD.account_id AS BINARY)<=>CAST(NEW.account_id AS BINARY)) OR NOT(OLD.bound_at<=>NEW.bound_at)))
 OR (OLD.status='BOUND' AND NEW.status<>'BOUND')
 OR (OLD.status='PRESENTED' AND (NEW.status<>'BOUND' OR NEW.intake_version<>0 OR NEW.bound_at>=NEW.expires_at))
 OR (OLD.status='BOUND' AND (NEW.intake_version<>OLD.intake_version+1 OR OLD.intake_state<>'DRAFT'))
 OR (OLD.status='BOUND' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth_physician_enrollment_intake_revisions r WHERE r.origin_id=OLD.origin_id
     AND r.account_id=OLD.account_id AND r.intake_version=NEW.intake_version AND r.submission_state=NEW.intake_state AND r.audit_reference=NEW.audit_reference))
 THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='enrollment_origin_transition_denied'; END IF;
END
